description: `notify` never calls `_load(args)` and never resolves a configured project by path — `--project` is a bare string ntfy_push never even reaches when no ntfy topic file exists (notify.py's `_read_topic`, backed by `MULTIVERSE_NTFY_TOPIC_FILE`/the config dir's `ntfy-topic`): `ntfy_push` returns `False` before any subprocess or network call, so `send` appends the message to the fleet outbox and reports `queued`, and the command still exits 0 (card 20261015-fixer-6e60a3's 'a caller of this command never sees a failure from the network itself'). A later `--flush` replays the same queued record through `send` again, hits the same no-topic short-circuit, and re-queues it — again with no network reached and exit 0.

expect.stderr: notify: ntfy unreachable, queued to outbox
notify: ntfy unreachable, queued to outbox
